steps.label: build
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_v2" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_v2" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/euv/"* . && cp "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_main/screen.jpg" . && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P euv.py -- save > b.log 2>&1 && grep -a 'EUV SAVED' b.log | cut -c1-300

steps.label: render 1-1588
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_v2" && for i in $(seq 1 40); do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b euv.blend -P euv_render.py -- render 1 1588 100 >> rall.log 2>&1; n=$(ls r | wc -l); echo "pass $i frames $n"; [ $n -ge 1588 ] && break; sleep 5; done; ls r | wc -l

steps.label: encode
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 25 -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_v2/r/f%04d.jpg" -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_v2/euv_mix.m4a" -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -shortest -movflags +faststart "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_v2/euv_mt_v2.mp4" && ls -l "$AGENT_HOME/work/euv_v2/euv_mt_v2.mp4"
